# emptea

> emptea studios is a small app studio in Switzerland making focused iPhone apps. Its first app is Crank, a fast workout tracker for strength training. Crank is free on the App Store.

## Crank

Crank is a native iPhone workout tracker built for speed.

- Log sets in seconds with templates and folders (for example a Push / Pull / Legs split); Crank remembers the weight and reps from last time.
- Body map: front and back, colored by the muscles you trained and the ones you skipped, weakest muscle first.
- PRs and strength standards: every lift graded from beginner to elite, with the gap to the next tier.
- Activity heatmap and a streak that counts weeks, not days.
- Leaderboards by strength, volume or consistency, worldwide or among friends, plus a feed of shared workouts.
- Share cards for Instagram Stories and group chats.
- Rest timer as a Live Activity on the Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets, Apple Health sync (steps and bodyweight in, workouts out), Siri Shortcuts and Spotlight.
- Hundreds of exercises with graphics, target muscles and full history; custom exercises.
- 9 city themes with light and dark modes. Available in 28 languages.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757124183

## More from emptea

Two more apps are in development. Details have not been announced.
